source_text: 改革开放以来，中国人的饮食（diet）发生了显著变化。过去由于经济落后，食品种类有限、数量不 足，人们仅仅满足于吃得饱。如今中国经济快速发展，食品不仅更加丰富多样，质量也大幅提高。随着 生活水平不断提升，人们对饮食的要求越来越高，更加注重吃得营养健康。因此，目前市场上推出的低脂、 低糖、有机食品受到人们的普遍欢迎。 ­
reference_translation: Since the reform and opening up, there have been significant changes in Chinese people's diet. In the past, due to the backward economy, the variety of food was limited and the quantity was insufficient, so people were only satisfied with having enough to eat. Now, with the rapid development of China's economy, the food is not only more diverse but also of much higher quality. As people's living standards continue to improve, they have higher and higher requirements for their diet and pay more attention to eating nutritiously and healthily. Therefore, low-fat, low-sugar and organic foods currently launched in the market are generally welcomed by people.
